properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 10 at 2:53AM EDT until September 10 at 7:00AM EDT by NWS Wilmington OH
properties.description:
At 253 AM EDT, local law enforcement reported flash flooding across
the warned area. Between 2.5 and 5.5 inches of rain have fallen.
Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are possible.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Law enforcement and local EMA reported significant flooding
occurring near the Highland County Fairgrounds, with rushing
water on SR-73. Additionally, multiple water rescues are
being reported out of Pike County.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams, urban
areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

Some locations that may experience flash flooding include...
Hillsboro, Waverly, Piketon, Marshall, Bainbridge, Kincaid Springs,
Cynthiana, Pike Lake, Highland Holiday, Rocky Fork Point, Russell,
New Market, Beaver, Sinking Spring, Idaho, Elm Grove, Buchanan,
Rainsboro, Summithill and Rocky Fork Lake.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

To report flash flooding, go to our website at weather.gov/iln and
submit your report via social media, when you can do so safely.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 9 at 10:48PM EDT until September 12 at 8:00AM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Florida...

Alafia River At Lithia affecting Hillsborough County.

Horse Creek Near Arcadia at SR 72 affecting DeSoto County.

...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

Little Manatee River At Wimauma at US 301 affecting Hillsborough
County.

Manatee River Near Myakka Head at SR 64 affecting Manatee County.

.Rising water levels are expected over the next several days along
several rivers across west central and southwest Florida due to
recent heavy rainfall.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Alafia River at Lithia .

* WHEN...From Thursday evening to Saturday morning.

* IMPACTS...At 13.0 feet, River Drive and Squirrel Run Way downstream
of County Road 640 are completely covered by water. One home begins
to flood.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 10:00 PM EDT Wednesday the stage was 8.0 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 13.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage early
Friday morning to a crest of 13.3 feet early Friday afternoon. It
will then fall below flood stage early Saturday morning.
- Flood stage is 13.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 13.3
feet on 08/26/1945.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:

deaths occur in vehicles.
